description_full: Aurora Cannabis Inc., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the production, distribution, and sale of cannabis products in Canada and internationally. The company offers pharmaceutical-grade cannabis products; and medical and consumer cannabis products. It also provides harvested cannabis, trim, cannabis oils, capsules, edibles, vaporizers, dried and fresh cannabis, cannabis plants, cannabis seeds, edible cannabis, cannabis extracts, flowers, vapes / inhalable extracts, edibles / pastilles, concentrates, and cannabis topicals; and patient counseling and outreach services. Its brand portfolio includes Aurora, Being, CanniMed, CraftPlant, Daily Special, Drift, Greybeard, IndiMed, MedReleaf, Pedanios, San Raf, Tasty's, Whistler, and WMMC. The company also engages in pharmacy activities. Aurora Cannabis Inc. was founded in 2013 and is headquartered in Edmonton, Canada.

financial_summary: Aurora Cannabis Inc. is a small-cap healthcare business with a $325M market cap on $242M of annual revenue.
The top line has compounded at +9% over the past three years, a respectable pace for a business of this size.
Returns on capital run at -15% against a 10% cost of capital, which means the business is destroying value with every dollar it reinvests, with gross margins sitting at 29%.
The company is burning through $2M of cash, and without positive owner earnings any valuation rests on hope rather than evidence.

On the balance sheet, the balance sheet carries net cash, which is the gold standard: the business never has to make desperate decisions in a bad year, and thin 0.6× interest coverage leaves no room for a bad year.

Shareholder yield is only 0.0%, a thin return of capital, and insider ownership is negligible, so management has little personal stake in the long-term outcome, and profit capture is only 0.2× the fair share, suggesting no structural edge inside its industry.
